To start our look into your athletic history, could you tell me a bit about your background in competitive sport?
Options: [I have a background in team sports | I am primarily an individual athlete (e.g., swimming, endurance) | I focus on strength and conditioning-based disciplines | I'm relatively new to structured, competitive training]
I am primarily an individual athlete (e.g., swimming, endurance)

What level of commitment does your current training typically demand, and what are you looking for in a new high-performance pathway?
Options: [I'm looking for a professional, full-time commitment. | I prefer a balanced approach alongside my other life responsibilities. | I am still testing the waters to see how far I can push my limits.]
I'm looking for a professional, full-time commitment.

When you envision yourself pushing toward the peak of a high-performance athletic pathway, what is the core driving force that keeps you motivated through those grueling, high-intensity training sessions?
Options: [The drive to push my physical and mental limits | The goal of competing at the highest international level | The satisfaction of mastering complex technical skills | The pursuit of long-term personal legacy]
The goal of competing at the highest international level
